answer: A seat opens only when signers from three separate branches co-sign it. The forge logs which agent admitted each vertex, which fixes every signer's branch, and a signer's k-th co-signature locks 10×k tide for a year. An honest newcomer recruits three ordinary signers and locks about 30 tide. An operator whose signers sit in three branches it controls must lock 10×k tide per signer for its k-th clone. Its 100th clone costs 3,000 tide, and 100 clones lock 151,500, unless it bribes unrelated branches to sign.
